comparison.objective: Separate loose ceramic media from washers, versus fastening a splash-shield panel with a push-in clip.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual sifting and bridge release versus aligning two holes and forcefully inserting a retaining clip.
comparison.success_condition: Mass-based recovery with no spill or washer loss versus aligned panel and fully seated, captured clip.
comparison.reason: The record tests precision alignment and insertion rather than bulk separation through apertures.
